prompt: Vertical 9:16 candid night photograph, camera low at the edge of a small sticky pub table, looking up. In sharp focus in the foreground lies a crumpled quiz answer sheet with a tiny pencil, the only writing on it the number "300,000". Just behind it, standing and already leaving, is the man from the attached reference sheet, rucksack on, rolled sleeping mat strapped across the top, half-turned back toward the room with a quiet, level look. Behind him, out of focus, a crowd of pub faces all turned toward him: hi-vis, a hen-party sash, a flat cap, mouths slightly open. Warm tungsten bar light, fruit-machine glow, red halation, coarse grain, cold teal rain on the window behind. Thanks.
